answer: Sample one submission in twelve and have an unrelated peer re-run it from the raw inputs; a mismatch voids the reward and charges the runner. Because payment vests over eighty epochs and no quorum may sit inside one subnetwork, a farm cannot self-audit and cannot cash out early. Twelve identities returning the same river gauge, marble cut and yarrow yield fail the re-run together, and the operator loses the batch instead of one seat.
